appName: City Car Parking & Driving Simulator VR
displayName: City Car Parking & Driving Simulator VR
display_name: City Car Parking & Driving Simulator VR
display_long_description:
City Car Parking & Driving Simulator VR delivers a realistic and immersive driving experience built from the ground up for virtual reality. Explore detailed city environments, master real-world parking challenges, and improve your driving skills with precise VR controls and authentic vehicle handling.
Navigate busy streets, tight parking spaces, and complex road layouts while following traffic rules and completing progressively challenging missions. From basic parking practice to advanced driving scenarios, every level is designed to test your accuracy, awareness, and control.
With smooth VR interaction, realistic car physics, and multiple camera perspectives, the simulator puts you directly behind the wheel. Whether you’re a beginner learning the basics or a driving enthusiast looking for a true-to-life experience, this simulator offers hours of engaging gameplay.
Key Features:
Immersive VR driving & parking simulation


Detailed city environments


Realistic car physics and controls


Multiple parking and driving challenges


Suitable for both casual players and simulation fans


Step into the driver’s seat, sharpen your skills, and experience city driving like never before — in VR.
